title: No Internet Access
description: My laptop says it is connected to Wi-Fi, but I cannot open any websites or internal applications.
symptoms: A nearby colleague has internet access.

questions.question: Can another device on the same Wi-Fi access the internet?
questions.answer: Yes. Other employees nearby are online.
questions.why: This makes a company-wide Wi-Fi outage less likely.

questions.question: Have you restarted the laptop?
questions.answer: Yes, twice. It did not help.
questions.why: A simple temporary client issue is less likely.

ipconfig.name: ipconfig
ipconfig.output:
IPv4 Address: 192.168.10.42
Default Gateway: 192.168.10.1
DNS Server: 192.168.10.53
ipconfig.why: The PC has an IP, gateway and DNS server.

gateway.name: ping 192.168.10.1
gateway.output:
Reply from 192.168.10.1: time=2ms
4 sent, 4 received, 0 lost
gateway.why: The PC can reach the local network gateway.

dns.name: ping 192.168.10.53
dns.output:
Request timed out.
4 sent, 0 received, 4 lost
dns.why: The configured DNS server cannot be reached.

lookup.name: nslookup example.com
lookup.output:
DNS request timed out.
Server: Unknown
Address: 192.168.10.53

explanation: The PC has a valid IP and can reach its gateway, but DNS traffic fails. That makes DNS the strongest hypothesis.

title: Computer Extremely Slow
description: My computer has become extremely slow. Even opening File Explorer takes ages.
symptoms: Applications take a long time to open.

questions.question: Did restarting fix it?
questions.answer: No. It is still slow after restarting.
questions.why: A temporary stuck process is less likely.

questions.question: Did anything change recently?
questions.answer: Windows installed an update last night.
questions.why: A recent change is worth investigating, but it is not proof of the cause.

task.name: Task Manager
task.why: Memory pressure is the strongest lead.

startup.name: Startup Apps
startup.why: Many startup applications can consume memory.

disk.name: Disk Space
disk.why: Low disk space is not the problem.

events.name: Event Viewer
events.output: No critical hardware or disk errors today.
events.why: A major hardware/disk failure is less likely.

explanation: Memory is at 96% while CPU and disk are low. The evidence points to memory pressure/background processes.

title: VPN Will Not Connect
description: I am working from home and the company VPN refuses to connect.

questions.question: Can you browse normal websites?
questions.why: General internet connectivity is probably fine.

questions.question: Did you recently change your password?
questions.why: Credential changes can affect saved VPN credentials.

vpn.name: VPN Client
vpn.why: The VPN server is reachable enough to reject authentication.

clock.name: System Time
clock.output: Local time is 7 minutes behind the domain time.
clock.why: Large clock differences can cause authentication problems.

explanation: Internet and DNS work, while the VPN specifically rejects authentication after a password change.

title: Printer Not Printing
description: The printer shows as available, but my documents stay stuck in the print queue.
symptoms: Three jobs are stuck in the queue.

questions.question: Can another employee print?
questions.why: The printer itself is probably operational.

questions.question: How many jobs are stuck?
questions.why: The problem may be local to this workstation.

queue.name: Print Queue
queue.output:
Job 1: Error
Job 2: Printing
Job 3: Pending
queue.why: A failed job may be blocking later jobs.

explanation: Other users can print, the printer is online, and this PC has a failed job blocking the queue.

title: Account Locked
description: I cannot sign in to my company account. It says the account is locked.
symptoms: The user can sign in to their phone.

questions.question: Did you recently change your password?
questions.why: Old saved credentials can continue trying to authenticate.

questions.question: Are you signed in anywhere else?
questions.answer: Yes, Outlook is still open on my old laptop.
questions.why: Another device may be using the old password.

identity.name: Account Status
identity.why: The account is locked after repeated failed authentication.

sessions.name: Active Sessions
sessions.why: The old laptop is still active.

logs.name: Authentication Logs
logs.why: The old laptop is generating the failures.

explanation: Authentication logs point directly to the old laptop repeatedly attempting the old password.

title: Shared Drive Access Denied
description: I can see the shared drive, but I get Access Denied when opening the Marketing folder.
symptoms: The shared drive appears in Explorer.
Other Marketing users can open the folder.

questions.question: Did you recently change departments?
questions.answer: Yes, I moved from HR to Marketing last week.
questions.why: Group membership may not have updated.

questions.question: Can a colleague access the folder?
questions.why: The share itself is working.

whoami.name: whoami /groups
whoami.why: The expected Marketing group is missing.

permissions.name: Folder Permissions
permissions.why: Access is controlled by the missing group.

explanation: The folder is online and permissions are granted to Marketing-Users, but the user is not in that group.

title: Outlook Not Syncing
description: New emails are not appearing in Outlook, but I can see them on my phone.

questions.question: Can you see new mail in webmail?
questions.why: The mailbox itself is working.

questions.question: Does Outlook show Working Offline?
questions.answer: Yes, I did not notice that.
questions.why: Outlook may simply be disconnected.

explanation: The mailbox works elsewhere and Outlook explicitly reports Working Offline.

title: Teams Microphone Not Working
description: People cannot hear me in Teams meetings.
symptoms: Teams shows the microphone but no input.

questions.question: Does the microphone work in another app?
questions.why: The hardware is probably functional.

questions.question: Is the Teams microphone muted?
questions.answer: The Teams mic icon is not muted.
questions.why: Look for device selection/permissions next.

teams.name: Teams Device Settings
teams.why: Teams is selecting the wrong microphone.

explanation: The headset works in Windows and permissions are allowed, but Teams is selecting the laptop microphone with no input.

title: USB Device Not Recognized
description: My USB security key is not detected by the computer.
symptoms: The USB key works on another PC.
Other USB devices work on this PC.
The issue started after a Windows update.

questions.question: Have you tried another USB port?
questions.why: A single bad port is unlikely.

questions.question: Does the device work elsewhere?
questions.why: The USB key itself is likely fine.

device.name: Device Manager
device.output: Unknown USB Device (Device Descriptor Request Failed)
device.why: The USB controller reports a device error.

events.name: Event Viewer
events.output: Repeated USB device descriptor errors after update.
events.why: The errors began after the update.

drivers.name: Driver Status
drivers.output: USB controller driver version changed after update.
drivers.why: The driver change is a strong lead.

explanation: The device works elsewhere and multiple ports work. Device Manager and Event Viewer point toward the USB driver.

title: Second Monitor Not Detected
description: My second monitor suddenly says No Signal.

questions.question: Did you reconnect the cable?
questions.why: A loose connection is less likely.

questions.question: Does Windows see the second display?
questions.why: Investigate display detection.

display.name: Display Settings
display.output:
Display 1: Dell U2422
Display 2: Not detected
display.why: Windows does not detect the second display.

dock.name: Dock Status
dock.output:
Dock firmware: update available
DisplayPort output: inactive
dock.why: The dock reports an inactive DisplayPort output.

explanation: The graphics adapter works and the monitor has power. The dock reports an inactive DisplayPort output.

title: Password Expired
description: I cannot sign in this morning. The message says my password has expired.
symptoms: The login explicitly says password expired.
The user has their current password.

questions.question: What does the exact message say?
questions.why: The error message already provides a strong lead.

questions.question: Can you access the password portal?
questions.why: The account and network are reachable.

account.name: Account Status
account.why: The account is active but the password is expired.

policy.name: Password Policy
policy.output:
Password maximum age: 90 days
Last changed: 91 days ago
policy.why: The password exceeded the policy limit.

explanation: The account is active and the password is 91 days old under a 90-day policy.

title: Application Crashes on Launch
description: The accounting application closes immediately after I open it.

questions.question: Do other applications work?
questions.why: The OS is generally functioning.

questions.question: Is there an error message?
questions.why: Logs may contain more information.

event.name: Event Viewer
event.output:
Application Error: accounting.exe
Faulting module: accounting.dll
event.why: The crash identifies the application DLL.

repair.name: App Repair
repair.why: The repair scan identifies a corrupted file.

explanation: The application alone crashes and the repair scan identifies a corrupted accounting.dll.

title: Windows Service Stopped
description: The internal scanning application cannot connect to its local agent.
symptoms: Other PCs can use the service.

questions.question: Can the PC reach internal sites?
questions.why: Basic network connectivity works.

questions.question: Did restarting the application help?
questions.why: Check the underlying service.

logs.name: Service Logs
logs.output: Error: failed to bind local port 4512
logs.why: The service cannot bind its required port.

explanation: The network is fine, while the required agent is stopped and its port is occupied by another process.

title: Wi-Fi Keeps Disconnecting
description: My laptop disconnects from Wi-Fi every few minutes.

questions.question: Does Ethernet stay connected?
questions.why: The issue is likely isolated to Wi-Fi.

questions.question: Does it happen in other rooms?
questions.why: Distance from one access point is less likely.

signal.name: Signal Strength
signal.why: Weak signal is not the cause.

explanation: Signal strength is excellent and Ethernet works. The Wi-Fi adapter is repeatedly resetting and has an outdated driver.

title: Suspicious Login Alert
description: I received a security alert for a login from a location I do not recognize.
symptoms: The login location is outside the Netherlands.

questions.question: Did you perform this login?
questions.why: This is potentially an account compromise.

questions.question: Did you receive an MFA prompt?
questions.answer: Yes, twice, but I denied it.
questions.why: Repeated unexpected MFA prompts are suspicious.

logs.name: Sign-in Logs
logs.why: There was a successful unknown login.

explanation: The user denies the login, an unknown session is active, and the sign-in system reports high risk and impossible travel.

title: DNS Only One Website Fails
description: Every website works except our supplier portal.
symptoms: Colleagues on the same network have the same issue.

questions.question: Can colleagues open the supplier portal?
questions.answer: No, everyone gets the same error.
questions.why: This may not be a single-PC problem.

questions.question: Does the portal require VPN?
questions.answer: Yes, it requires the company VPN.
questions.why: Check VPN/DNS rather than the browser.

dns.name: nslookup supplier.example
dns.why: DNS is returning that the name does not exist.

public.name: Public DNS Test
public.why: The name fails outside the local network too.

explanation: Multiple users are affected and both company and public DNS return NXDOMAIN. The supplier DNS record is the strongest lead.

title: Laptop Battery Drains Quickly
description: My laptop battery is almost empty after an hour even though I barely use it.
symptoms: The laptop is warm when idle.

questions.question: Is the CPU high while idle?
questions.why: High idle usage can explain heat and battery drain.

questions.question: Does it charge normally?
questions.why: The charger is likely not the issue.

task.name: Task Manager
task.why: A backup process is consuming most CPU.

service.name: Backup Agent
service.why: A process is running far longer than expected.

explanation: Battery health is good. A backup process consuming 64% CPU is causing the heat and rapid drain.

title: Cannot Install Software
description: I need to install a company-approved application, but Windows asks for administrator credentials.
symptoms: The user is not an administrator.
Other employees received the software through Company Portal.

questions.question: Is the application available in Company Portal?
questions.why: The managed installation route may avoid admin rights.

questions.question: Are you a local administrator?
questions.why: Manual installation may be restricted by policy.

whoami.name: whoami /groups
whoami.output:
Users: Standard User
Administrators: Not present

portal.name: Company Portal
portal.output:
Approved App: Available
Install: Requires no elevation

explanation: The organization blocks unmanaged installers. The approved application is already available through Company Portal.

title: File Deleted by User
description: I accidentally deleted an important spreadsheet from the shared Finance folder.
symptoms: The file was deleted this morning.

questions.question: Did you check the Recycle Bin?
questions.why: Check server-side recovery.

questions.question: Do you know the exact filename?
questions.why: The exact name helps locate backups/version history.

backup.name: Backup System
backup.why: A backup exists but is older.

permissions.name: Folder Permissions
permissions.output:
User: Read/Modify
Restore: IT Admin only

explanation: Version history has a copy from 09:42 today, making it the fastest and least destructive recovery option.

title: PC Cannot Join Company Network
description: A newly issued laptop connects to Wi-Fi but cannot access internal company resources.
symptoms: The laptop is new and was just enrolled.

questions.question: Can you reach public websites?
questions.why: The local network and internet are working.

questions.question: Was the laptop recently enrolled?
questions.why: Device management/network policy may not have finished applying.

ipconfig.name: ipconfig /all
ipconfig.why: The laptop is using public DNS instead of company DNS.

dns.name: nslookup intranet.company.local
dns.why: Internal DNS cannot resolve the company hostname.

mdm.name: Device Management
mdm.why: The managed network profile has not applied.

routes.name: route print
routes.why: There is no route to the internal network.

explanation: Public internet works, but the laptop uses public DNS and has no route to the internal network. The managed network profile is still pending.
